integrity.proof_basis: exact cyclic interval representation, inball feasibility inequalities, balance parity, convexity, and cube-section vertex enumeration
integrity.verification_limits: Finite numerical and exact-rank checks corroborate but are not infinite proofs

scientific_limitations: Only simple unweighted cycle graphs with standard generator normalization and the intrinsic Euclidean metric.
The corresponding classifications for positively weighted cycles and general connected graphs are not asserted.
Older literature under alternate terminology may contain an equivalent full incenter-locus classification.
title: Complete Euclidean incenter loci of cycle graphical zonotopes
